data.reason_zh: 提出冻结模型下外部工具与技能持续修订框架，轨迹反馈驱动修改，并保留修订供后续行动与自我改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections.
scope_support.object_quote: A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections.
scope_support.persistence_quote: The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement.
